label: St Bartholomew, Apostle (S. BARTHOLOMAEI, APOSTOLI, Die 24 augusti)

chants.incipit: Vos qui secuti estis me dicit Dominus
chants.notes: Printed as 'CO. Vos qui secuti estis me, VI, 438.' The trailing 'VI' is an OPTION MARKER (the sixth communio of the Commune Apostolorum on p438), not a mode. p438 holds two communios whose incipits prefix one another, so the spec incipit is extended to the target page's full index form ('...dicit Dominus', mode 2) to select option VI rather than option V.
